body.x: GOYANG, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2006') -- <Visual News> DK Vascom, Korean retailer of Sennheiser, presented ''MX70VC Sport'' during KES 2006, which features magnetic surfaces to prevent the cables from getting entangled and waterproof feature. Suggesting price is 40,000(KRW).

< AVING Special Report Team for ''KES 2006'': Publisher & Editor, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Caleb Ma, Jason Lee, Gaius Park, Phoebe Kwon, Sheri Choi, Joshua Shim, Daniel Sirh, Rose Kim, Paul Kim, Samuel Kim, Abe Shim, Grace Won >
